name: MonarchTimeGrid
title: TimeGrid
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row and Box columns in androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll and a shared androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll, MonarchEventChip blocks and bars, androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectDragGesturesAfterLongPress, androidx.compose.ui.semantics.CustomAccessibilityAction and androidx.compose.ui.hapticfeedback.HapticFeedbackType
summary: The day and week view of a calendar: an hour gutter, an all-day row and one column per day, with overlapping events side by side, a now line, working-hours shading, unavailable blocks, tap to create and long press and drag to move.
whenToUse: For a calendar's day or week view, a booking schedule or a rota where the time of day matters. Put MonarchCalendarToolbar above it to change days and views, and open events in MonarchEventPopover or a sheet.
whenNotToUse: For upcoming events listed by day, use MonarchAgendaList, which reads better on a narrow phone; to pick a day, use MonarchMiniMonth or the Material 3 DatePicker. Do not put it inside another vertical scroll: the hours scroll themselves.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTimeGrid(days: List<Long>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, events: List<MonarchAgendaEvent> = emptyList(), now: Long? = System.currentTimeMillis(), startHour: Int = 0, endHour: Int = 24, hourHeight: Dp = Dp.Unspecified, snapMinutes: Int = 15, workingHours: List<MonarchTimeGridWorkingHours>? = null, unavailable: List<MonarchTimeGridUnavailable> = emptyList(), scrollToMinutes: Int? = null, showAllDayRow: Boolean = false, timeZone: String? = null, labels: MonarchTimeGridLabels = MonarchTimeGridLabels(), canMoveEvent: ((MonarchAgendaEvent) -> Boolean)? = null, onSelectDay: ((Long) -> Unit)? = null, onSelectSlot: ((MonarchTimeGridSlot) -> Unit)? = null, onSelectEvent: ((MonarchAgendaEvent) -> Unit)? = null, onMoveEvent: ((MonarchTimeGridMove) -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchTimeGridSlot(day: Long, minutes: Int, start: Long)
class MonarchTimeGridMove(event: MonarchAgendaEvent, start: Long, end: Long)
class MonarchTimeGridUnavailable(id: String, start: Long, end: Long, label: String? = null)
class MonarchTimeGridWorkingHours(weekday: Int, start: Int, end: Int)

class MonarchTimeGridLabels(allDay: String? = null, createEvent: ((String) -> String)? = null, today: String? = null, openDay: ((String) -> String)? = null, range: ((String, String) -> String)? = null, until: ((String) -> String)? = null, moveEarlier: String? = null, moveLater: String? = null, moveToPreviousDay: String? = null, moveToNextDay: String? = null)

options.name: days
options.description: The day columns in order, one for a day view, seven for a week, as day keys: the UTC midnight of each date, as DatePickerState and MonarchMiniMonth give.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the grid. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: events
options.description: The events, the same model as MonarchAgendaList. Timed events are placed by start and end (exclusive); all-day events go in the all-day row of each day they cover.

options.name: now
options.description: The current time for the now line and today's heading; null hides both. Pass a value that changes every minute to move the line.

options.name: endHour
options.description: The end of the visible hours (exclusive), 1 to 24. At least one hour is shown.

options.name: hourHeight
options.description: The height of one hour. Unspecified is 64dp, or 48dp times the font scale when that is more.

options.name: snapMinutes
options.description: Taps, drags and TalkBack moves snap to this many minutes, 1 to 60.

options.name: workingHours
options.description: Working hours per ISO weekday (1 Monday to 7 Sunday) in minutes from midnight; time outside them is shaded. null shades nothing.

options.name: unavailable
options.description: Blocks drawn hatched with an optional label, such as time off or a closure.

options.name: scrollToMinutes
options.description: Minutes from midnight to scroll to when the grid appears and when the first day or the number of days changes. null is an hour before the earliest visible event, else 08:00.

options.name: showAllDayRow
options.description: Shows the all-day row even when no all-day event is visible.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone events are placed and times are written in. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: canMoveEvent
options.description: Which events may be moved. null allows all, when onMoveEvent is set.

options.name: onSelectDay
options.description: Makes the headings of a multi-day grid buttons, for example to open the day view. Receives the day key.

options.name: onSelectSlot
options.description: Called when an empty part of a column is tapped, with the time snapped down to snapMinutes. Also makes every hour of every column a TalkBack button.

options.name: onSelectEvent
options.description: Opens an event. Without it events are not buttons.

options.name: onMoveEvent
options.description: Turns on moving events by long press and drag and by TalkBack actions. The grid does not change the events; the app applies or confirms the move.

states.name: week
states.description: Several columns with weekday and date headings; overlapping events share the column width side by side.

states.name: day
states.description: One column; its heading is a heading, not a button.

states.name: today
states.description: Today's date sits on a filled accent circle, its heading is read with "Today", and the now line with its dot crosses its column when now is inside the visible hours.

states.name: all-day row
states.description: Shown when an all-day event is visible or showAllDayRow is on: an "All day" label in the gutter and bar chips per day.

states.name: working hours
states.description: Time outside the working hours of each weekday is shaded.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: A hatched block with its label; taps still reach the slot under it.

states.name: short event
states.description: Events under 45 minutes are one line, start time then title; events of 70 minutes or more also show their detail. A tappable event is drawn at least 48dp tall.

states.name: wide
states.description: When the columns need more room than the width (narrow phone, many days, events side by side), the days scroll sideways together with their headings and all-day row; the hour gutter stays.

states.name: moving
states.description: After a long press the event is picked up with a haptic, a dashed ghost shows the new time and title, scrolling pauses, and each step ticks. Releasing calls onMoveEvent when the start changed.

states.name: read only
states.description: Without callbacks the grid only shows events.

appearance: The grid sits on the surface background with subtle border lines for hours and columns and a default border under the headings. Hour labels, weekdays and the all-day label use the muted text color; today's date is in the accent on-solid color on an accent solid circle; the now line is the danger solid color. Shading is the subtle background, unavailable blocks the muted background with default-border hatching. Events are MonarchEventChip blocks in their own color or the accent. Every role comes from the theme, so the dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web TimeGrid reads ISO days in an IANA zone, drags with a pointer only (touch keeps scrolling), moves focus between hour slots with the arrow keys and takes a renderEvent wrapper. On Android days are day keys in epoch milliseconds and events are placed in the zone of an IANA id; moving is long press then drag, as in Google Calendar, with system haptics; TalkBack gets named move actions instead of keyboard dragging, and hardware keyboards move between slots and events with Compose's focus search, not the web's arrow-key map. There is no renderEvent: onSelectEvent gives the app the event to show in MonarchEventPopover or a sheet. The web's hourCycle and locale come from the configuration's locale. Unlike the web and iOS, a column widens and the days scroll sideways when events side by side would be narrower than 48dp, and tappable events are drawn at least 48dp tall (overlaps are packed by the drawn length), so every target keeps 48dp. Drag to create a range and auto-scrolling while dragging near an edge are not offered. Events reuse MonarchAgendaEvent, as on iOS, whose MonarchTimeGrid has the same parameters (Compose callbacks instead of bindings, timeZone instead of calendar).
accessibility: Each day heading is one element read as "Wednesday, November 4", with ", Today" on today; it is a heading, or a button with the click label "Open Wednesday, November 4" when onSelectDay is set in a multi-day grid, with a 48dp target.
Each event is a MonarchEventChip read as one element: title, time spoken in full ("9:30 AM to 11:00 AM"), status and detail; with onSelectEvent it is a button with a 48dp target.

A movable event has the TalkBack actions Move earlier, Move later (by snapMinutes), Move to previous day and Move to next day, each offered only when the move is possible, so it can be rescheduled without dragging.
With onSelectSlot every hour of every column is a button read as "Create event, Wednesday, November 4, 9:00 AM"; TalkBack and keyboards create at the start of the hour.
Each column is a traversal group named with its long date.
Unavailable blocks are read with their label and times ("Closed, 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM"); shading, the hour gutter, grid lines, the now line and the drag ghost are hidden.
Today is marked by a word and a filled shape, not by color alone; statuses are words read by the event chip.
Hour height grows with the font size, and right to left the first day is at the right.
edgeCases: Daylight-saving days still show 24 rows: events are placed by wall-clock time, so a skipped hour leaves a gap and a repeated hour overlaps; a slot in a skipped hour starts at the next valid time.
An event that ends exactly at midnight does not appear on the next day; a multi-day timed event is clipped on each day it touches.
Events outside startHour to endHour are hidden; events crossing the edges are clipped.
An event with no end, or an end before its start, is drawn snapMinutes long (or 48dp when it can be tapped).
A moved event keeps its duration; a move is clamped so the whole event stays in the visible hours, and a move that would not change the start is not reported.
A week on a narrow phone scrolls sideways; consider three days, or MonarchAgendaList.

examples.title: Work week
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    MonarchTimeGrid(
        days = listOf({{days.0|millis}}, {{days.1|millis}}, {{days.2|millis}}, {{days.3|millis}}, {{days.4|millis}}),
        modifier = Modifier.height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 4),
        events = listOf(
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t1", title = {{events.0.title}}, start = {{events.0.start|millis}}, end = {{events.0.end|millis}}, allDay = {{events.0.allDay}}, color = hex({{events.0.color}})),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t2", title = {{events.1.title}}, start = {{events.1.start|millis}}, end = {{events.1.end|millis}}, color = hex({{events.1.color}})),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t3", title = {{events.2.title}}, start = {{events.2.start|millis}}, end = {{events.2.end|millis}}, detail = {{events.2.detail}}, color = hex({{events.2.color}})),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t4", title = {{events.3.title}}, start = {{events.3.start|millis}}, end = {{events.3.end|millis}}, color = hex({{events.3.color}}), status = MonarchEventChipStatus.{{events.3.status|pascal}}),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t5", title = {{events.4.title}}, start = {{events.4.start|millis}}, end = {{events.4.end|millis}}, color = hex({{events.4.color}})),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t6", title = {{events.5.title}}, start = {{events.5.start|millis}}, end = {{events.5.end|millis}}, color = hex({{events.5.color}}), status = MonarchEventChipStatus.{{events.5.status|pascal}}),
            MonarchAgendaEvent(id = "t7", title = {{events.6.title}}, start = {{events.6.start|millis}}, end = {{events.6.end|millis}}, color = hex({{events.6.color}})),
        ),
        now = {{now|millis}},
        workingHours = listOf({{workingDays.0}}, {{workingDays.1}}, {{workingDays.2}}, {{workingDays.3}}, {{workingDays.4}}).flatMap { weekday ->
            listOf(
                MonarchTimeGridWorkingHours(weekday = weekday, start = {{workingHours.0.start}}, end = {{workingHours.0.end}}),
                MonarchTimeGridWorkingHours(weekday = weekday, start = {{workingHours.1.start}}, end = {{workingHours.1.end}}),
            )
        },
        unavailable = listOf(
            MonarchTimeGridUnavailable(id = "off", start = {{unavailable.0.start|millis}}, end = {{unavailable.0.end|millis}}, label = {{unavailable.0.label}}),
        ),
        scrollToMinutes = {{scrollToMinutes}},
        showAllDayRow = true,
        timeZone = {{timeZone}},
    )
}

examples.title: A day view with a closure and opening hours
examples.code:
MonarchTimeGrid(
    days = listOf(day),
    modifier = Modifier.height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 3),
    now = day + 10 * 3_600_000L,
    startHour = 7,
    endHour = 20,
    unavailable = listOf(
        MonarchTimeGridUnavailable("lunch", day + 12 * 3_600_000L, day + 13 * 3_600_000L, label = "Closed"),
    ),
    timeZone = "UTC",
)

parityExceptions.reason: The event block is named for TalkBack with its title and time range separated by commas ("Stand-up, 09:00 to 09:15"); the web label runs title, time and range together.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
